This would (and did) inflate the set with non-winner names, yielding 67 unique 'winners' in Step 6—impossible given 44 seasons with only two repeat champions (i.e., at most 42 unique winners). This erroneous count was then accepted in Step 7 and used in the final calculation, making Step 5 the first uncorrected mistake that contributed to the final wrong outcome. Earlier errors (Steps 1–4) were not used in the final result, and later steps did not correct the Step 5 mistake.
